playground.note: Own-pedal only, reusable, never distributed; the scratch range is 0x1000-0x13ff. The older 0x0f00-0x0fff page also works but Zoom occupies both ends of it.

reserved.note: Reserved. Do not pick ids from it.

band.note: Author identity is the low16 range; the group byte (top byte of the id) is the on-pedal category and is set per target pedal. Nothing with low16 < 0x2000 is distributed (neither the effect nor a patch that references it): 0x1000-0x13ff is the playground, free to use on your own pedal, and 0x1400-0x1fff is reserved. Distributed effects live in an author range at 0x2000 or above. Do not pick one yourself: open an issue in this repo to get a range assigned.

filename_prefixes.note: The pedal stores effects by an 8-character flash filename, a namespace separate from the id, and an install over an existing same-name file silently keeps the old file. So filenames need a namespace too: every author gets a unique 2-letter prefix together with their id range, and every distributed effect's filename starts with its author's prefix (2 prefix + up to 6 name characters). Playground builds start with XX instead, or with the author's own prefix. The build tool enforces this; the safe installer refuses a filename collision with a different effect at install time.

reserved.XX: playground marker: experimental, own-pedal builds by any author; never a personal prefix

authors.name: Thomas Hammer
authors.note: For effects I distribute. The effects in this repo are examples and stay in the playground (0x...1000..0x...1030), not in this range.
